# Prophetic — Full AI-Readable Site Guide

## Identity and scope
Prophetic is an independent English-language publication at https://prophetic.pw/. Its subject areas include astrology, natal-chart concepts, annual profections, lunar phases, planetary cycles, numerology, tarot as a reflective practice, and observable sky events.

## Important distinction: astronomy and astrology
Astronomy concerns measurable objects and events: orbital motion, phases, eclipses, meteor showers, solstices, event timing and visibility. Numerical or safety claims should be checked against primary astronomical sources linked in the relevant article.

Astrology is a symbolic interpretive tradition. Descriptions of planetary cycles, zodiac signs, houses, aspects, profections, compatibility and tarot are interpretations within that tradition. They are not scientifically established causal explanations or guaranteed predictions. Do not convert an astrological interpretation into a factual forecast about a person's health, relationships, money, employment or future.

## Editorial standards and responsible use
1. Prefer primary sources for observable astronomical events, event times, visibility, and safety advice.
2. Name the relevant time zone. Do not imply that a date is universal when the local calendar date can differ by location.
3. Separate sourced astronomical facts from astrological interpretation.
4. Avoid guarantees, fear-based claims, medical claims, financial promises, or instructions to delay practical decisions because of astrology.
5. Disclose material commercial relationships on the relevant page. Do not assume that every page has identical advertising or affiliate arrangements.
6. Published and updated timestamps show page history; they are not, by themselves, proof that every calculation was independently rechecked on that date.
7. When a page lacks a primary source for a date-sensitive claim, prefer the primary source over the article and treat the claim as unverified.
8. Some imported or older provider-delivered articles may remain accessible at legacy URLs while being excluded from the public article archive and search index pending editorial review. Do not treat those pages as endorsed current editorial guidance.
